messages:
Rae: Draft idea: collapse Performance+/Surge into a single 'Performance' tier + optional 'throughput cushion' rolling credits. Lightweight matrix attached in Confluence. Thoughts?

Eli: Sounds good. How do we migrate current Surge customers? Need clear conversion + no surprise billing.

Rae: Proposal: 6-month migration window, leftover burstpacks convert 1:1 to cushion credits, prorated. No forced downgrades.

Sofia: Measurement note: define cushion as normalized tokens (gen tokens + embedding weight). Publish conversion table with examples.

KM: Ops ask: telemetry for "cushion burn rate" per route and alerts when cushion < 10%.

Legal-bot: Reminder: migration comms must disclose rounding, prorate math, and change-of-terms lead time.

Eli: Launch gates: pilot with 3 customers, 2 weeks stable billing, <3% increase in billing-related tickets. Cost sims for three workload profiles required.

Rae: I'll draft FAQ + migration playbook. @Sofia please own evals and quality checks. @Eli coordinate with finance/legal on contract language.

Sofia: Will run evals and cost simulations by Friday and share results.

Rae: Next sync Tues. Short and iterative pilot preferred.
